items.exampleEn: The fans grieved when their favorite band broke up.
items.exampleZh: 最喜歡的樂團解散時，歌迷們都很難過。

items.exampleEn: The news made everyone feel gloomy.
items.exampleZh: 那則消息讓大家心情都很低落。

items.exampleEn: He gave a witty speech at his sister's wedding.
items.exampleZh: 他在他姊妹的婚禮上發表了一篇風趣的致詞。

items.exampleEn: The colors of the sunset were breathtaking.
items.exampleZh: 夕陽的顏色美得令人屏息。

items.exampleEn: He plays the violin very passionately.
items.exampleZh: 他拉小提琴拉得很投入、很熱情。

items.exampleEn: Our coach is stern but fair.
items.exampleZh: 我們的教練很嚴格，但很公平。

items.exampleEn: She has an innate talent for music.
items.exampleZh: 她有與生俱來的音樂天分。

items.exampleEn: Winning second place was a small consolation.
items.exampleZh: 得到第二名算是小小的安慰。

items.sentenceEn: It's normal to grieve when a close friend moves far away.
items.sentenceZh: 好朋友搬到很遠的地方時，感到難過是正常的。

items.audioEn: My aunt's witty messages always make my day better.
items.audioZh: 我阿姨風趣的訊息總是讓我一整天心情變好。
items.questionZh: 說話者覺得阿姨的訊息怎麼樣？

items.sentenceEn: Some people believe that language ability is innate.
items.sentenceZh: 有些人認為語言能力是天生的。

items.sentenceEn: The old house looked gloomy in the rain.
items.sentenceZh: 那棟老房子在雨中看起來很陰沉。

items.stemEn: His love of order seems ____; even as a baby he lined up his toys.
items.stemZh: 他愛整齊似乎是天生的，還是嬰兒時就會把玩具排成一排。

items.stemEn: My father gave me a ____ look when I came home at two in the morning.
items.stemZh: 我凌晨兩點才回家，爸爸嚴厲地看了我一眼。

items.passageEn: Last month, my family took a boat trip to see whales. The sky was gloomy, and before we left, the captain gave us a stern warning to stay seated when the sea was rough. Our guide was witty, and she spoke passionately about whales. She told us that young whales do not have to be taught to swim; it is innate. She also said that it is a misconception that all whales are huge, because some are smaller than a car. For an hour we saw nothing, but then a whale jumped high out of the water. It was breathtaking. On the way back, the captain gave everyone hot chocolate as a consolation for the cold.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我們全家搭船去賞鯨。那天天色陰沉，出發前船長嚴厲地警告我們，海浪大的時候要坐在位子上。我們的嚮導很風趣，熱情地介紹鯨魚。她告訴我們，小鯨魚不用人教就會游泳，那是天生的。她還說，以為所有鯨魚都很巨大是一種誤解，因為有些鯨魚比一台車還小。我們有一個小時什麼也沒看到，然後一頭鯨魚高高躍出水面，美得令人屏息。回程時，船長請每個人喝熱巧克力，安慰大家受了寒。

questions.questionZh: 出發前，船長提醒了什麼？
options: 一定要穿救生衣才能上船
看到鯨魚時不可以大聲尖叫

questions.questionZh: 船長為什麼請大家喝熱巧克力？
options: 慶祝大家第一次看到鯨魚

items.promptZh: 那位歌手的聲音美得令人屏息。
referenceEn: The singer's voice was absolutely breathtaking.
That singer has a truly breathtaking voice.
rubricZh: breathtaking 的用法，例如 absolutely breathtaking、a breathtaking voice 等
時態合理（例如 was、has 等）

items.promptZh: 在那段難過的日子裡，我在音樂中找到了慰藉。
referenceEn: During that sad time, I found consolation in music.
I found great consolation in music during that difficult time.
rubricZh: consolation 表示「安慰、慰藉」，例如 find consolation in… 等
「那段難過的日子」可寫，例如 during that sad time、during those difficult days 等
時態可用過去式（例如 found 等）
